questions.question: 1. Which of the following is true in the KMP string searching algorithm? (strInd = iterator in the main string)

answers.a: The value of strInd always increases in all iterations.
answers.b: The value of strInd remains the same in all iterations.
answers.c: The value of strInd may or may not increase in all iterations, but it never decreases.

explanations.a: Incorrect. strInd can remain the same during a mismatch.
explanations.b: Incorrect. strInd does not always remain the same; it advances when characters match.
explanations.c: Correct. strInd may stay the same during a mismatch, but it never decreases in the KMP algorithm.

questions.question: 2. How does KMP improve the brute-force method?

answers.a: By comparing the characters right to left instead of left to right.
answers.b: By searching for text in the pattern instead of the pattern in the string.
answers.c: By avoiding redundant comparisons and using information from previous matches.

explanations.a: Incorrect. KMP compares left to right, not right to left.
explanations.b: Incorrect. KMP searches for the pattern in the string, not the other way around.
explanations.c: Correct. KMP uses the LPS array to avoid redundant comparisons, making it more efficient than brute-force.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Only option c is correct.

questions.question: 3. What is the first step in the KMP algorithm before searching for the pattern in the text?

answers.b: Compute the LPS (Longest Prefix Suffix) array for the pattern.
answers.d: Count the number of pattern occurrences in the text.

explanations.a: Incorrect. Sorting is not part of KMP.
explanations.b: Correct. The first step is to compute the LPS array for the pattern.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Reversing the text is not required.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Counting occurrences is not the first step.

questions.question: 4. Which of the following is NOT a possible value in the LPS array for the pattern 'ABABAC'?

explanations.a: Incorrect. 0 is a valid value in the LPS array.
explanations.b: Incorrect. 1 is a valid value in the LPS array.
explanations.c: Incorrect. 2 is a valid value in the LPS array.
explanations.d: Correct. 4 is not a possible value in the LPS array for 'ABABAC'.

questions.question: 5. Which of the following best describes the worst-case time complexity of the KMP algorithm? (M = length of pattern, N = length of text)

explanations.a: Incorrect. O(M*N) is the naive algorithm's complexity.
explanations.b: Correct. KMP runs in O(M+N) time in the worst case.
explanations.c: Incorrect. O(M^N) is not the correct complexity.
explanations.d: Incorrect. O(N^2) is not the correct complexity.

questions.question: 6. Which of the following is a limitation of the KMP algorithm?

answers.a: It cannot handle patterns with repeated characters.
answers.b: It requires additional space for the LPS array.
answers.c: It only works for numeric strings.

explanations.a: Incorrect. KMP can handle repeated characters in the pattern.
explanations.b: Correct. KMP requires extra space for the LPS array.
explanations.c: Incorrect. KMP works for any string, not just numeric.
explanations.d: Incorrect. KMP can find overlapping patterns.
